about_short_description.short_description: Haystack is an employee experience platform that connects the company's communication, knowledge, and people to a single platform.

product.name: Haystack Intranet Platform
product.description: A cloud-based employee experience platform that centralizes communication, knowledge, and people into a single accessible interface.

product.name: Communication Tools
product.description: Tools for creating, scheduling, and delivering internal communications across multiple channels including email, SMS, and mobile apps.

product.name: Employee Directory
product.description: A dynamic, searchable employee directory with rich profiles, organizational charts, and customizable groups to facilitate connections.

product.name: Knowledge Base
product.description: A centralized knowledge management system that stores, organizes, and makes company information easily searchable and accessible.

product.name: Secure Delivery
product.description: A security feature that protects sensitive communications by preventing unauthorized sharing and ensuring message authenticity.

product.name: Emergency Alerts
product.description: A system for sending urgent SMS notifications to employees to ensure critical information is received promptly.
